label: Bitly
description: Link shortening service for creating, managing, and tracking branded short URLs.
notes: All five piece actions transpiled in simplified form. createBitlink: dropped optional group_guid/domain (API defaults to the account's default group and bit.ly), title, tags (JSON array), force_new_link (JSON boolean), and deeplinks (nested array) — none can be conditionally included or typed by the template runtime; the API defaults cover the core use case. updateBitlink: reduced to title-only update — archived (boolean), tags (array), and deeplinks require typed JSON; archiving is covered by the dedicated archiveBitlink node whose body is the static literal {"archived": true}. createQrCode: kept the long_url destination variant with required group_guid; dropped the bitlink_id destination variant (AP DynamicProperties) and every render_customizations style option (deeply nested objects with numeric/boolean fields). Dynamic dropdowns (group, bitlink, domain) became plain text fields with help hints. Bitlink IDs are path segments containing a slash (bit.ly/abc123), so they are substituted raw into the URL, matching the piece's client. The piece's generic custom-API-call action was skipped as non-specific.
